Your inquiry details

A little clarity
about your information.

How this website handles the information you enter.

Your inquiry form

The form prepares a message in your browser. This website does not submit your inquiry to a server, store it in a database, or send it automatically. Form values remain on the open page and are not saved by the site when you leave.

When you choose Open Email Draft, your email application receives the prepared message. When you choose Copy for Messenger, the message is copied to your clipboard so you can paste it into Facebook Messenger. Review your details and send the message yourself. The resort receives only the information you choose to send.

External services

Links to Facebook, Messenger, Google Maps, Trip.com, and other source websites open services with their own privacy policies. The location map uses Google Maps. Fonts are served locally. This website does not add advertising trackers or analytics.

After you contact the resort

For questions about how Treasure Trove Resort handles information sent to it, contact info@treasuretroveph.com or 0997 882 7572.
